title: ProfilesModel save tests leave temporary AWS folders behind
reasoning: The save tests create unique directories under FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory but never remove them. The load tests in the same test group use defer cleanup, which shows the intended pattern. Repeated local and CI runs will accumulate config fixtures and can eventually pollute temp storage or make debugging test artifacts harder.
reproduction: Run the ProfilesModelSaveTests repeatedly and inspect the system temporary directory for UUID-named folders containing generated AWS config files.
recommendation: Add `defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: folder) }` immediately after each temp folder creation, or wrap temp-folder setup in a helper that runs the test body and always cleans up.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The assertions only inspect written config contents; none assert cleanup or use a helper that guarantees cleanup after failures.
minimumFixScope: ProfilesModelSaveTests temp-folder setup in the four save tests.
